scope: All 600 synthetic dev cases, two pipelines, actual bid graph and real configured local model. Existing B2 retrieval metrics remain separately identified.
outcome_policy: Scripted approval only for unblocked proposals inside disposable project-owned GigSim. No real marketplace writes. Report per-submission and per-fixed-job-set outcomes with denominators.
price_gold: Synthetic development price_band; missing bands excluded and counted.
judge_policy: Fixed 0-4 overall rubric, labels gathered on 30 items by the author. No calibrated-score claim until human labels exist and kappa is computed. Raw judge output remains provisional.
panel_policy: 15 anonymous matched V0/V8 pairs, five per persona; random left/right allocation. Require at least two self-attested classmate raters; no automated panel votes.
usd_policy: Local model endpoint only: billed inference API cost 0 USD. Hardware/electricity cost unknown and excluded, not assumed free.
failure_policy: Persist errors, empty/blocked drafts and timeouts; never silently count them as good proposals or remove them from attempted-case denominators. Resume only incomplete cases.
